# Chapter 1: Reality and method

Critical realism starts from the claim that the world exists independently of our knowledge of it (Bhaskar, 1975). The the domains of reality are layered.

**Ontology** is the study of what exists. Ontology asks different questions from epistemology, as Archer (1995) argues at length.

## References

Archer, M. S. (1995). Realist Social Theory: The Morphogenetic Approach. Cambridge University Press.

Bhaskar, R. (1975). A Realist Theory of Science. Leeds Books.
